title: Orbital curtain-wall construction

specimens.name: Thermally broken mullion
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 1 ONLY. Preserve broad clear glass and thermally broken mullion with polymer bridges. Replace broad white panel on right side with solid metal side face bearing ONE inset narrow vertical frosted LED diffuser, width less than one tenth of its length, facing the passage. Unlit, no halo.

specimens.name: Point supported glass
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 2 ONLY. One atomic fragment. clear corner, one through bolt, broad washer on elastomer and spherical rear seat.

specimens.name: Sill shoe
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 3 ONLY. Frontal cutaway of upright glass sitting DIRECTLY ON TOP of one distinct dark rectangular setting block beneath its lower edge. Clear air gaps on both sides between glass and the U shoe. Cut away front wall to expose the vertical load path and full contact. No lateral block.

specimens.name: Secondary catch
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 4 ONLY. One atomic fragment. intact laminated glass corner with one safety finger hovering over edge with visible clearance.

specimens.name: Weep outlet
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 1 ONLY. One atomic fragment. bare sill cutaway, inclined floor and single low offset drain slot under hood.

specimens.name: Perimeter firestop
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 2 ONLY. One atomic fragment. slab edge and short tray with one compressed fibrous wedge bridging the cavity.

specimens.name: Floating louver bracket
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 3 ONLY. One atomic fragment. one glass blade end and captive pin centered in elongated slot with clear travel both ways.

specimens.name: Overlap joint
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 4 ONLY. Two separately held flat rectangular glass fragments. Their straight vertical square cut ends face each other across a wide gap. Inside this gap ONLY, show two dark graphite METAL Z sections, one attached to each edge through its own narrow metal shoe. Their flat horizontal lips overlap with a thin visible empty background slot between them, forming one labyrinth joint. Keep glass ends straight and well outside the overlap. No bent, stepped or interlocking glass.
